label: Dairy spread
note: EU legal category for milk-fat spreads outside the butter grades: under 39 %, 41-60 % or 62-80 % milk fat

about.text: A spreadable milk-fat product that falls outside the butter categories: under 39 %, between 41 and 60 %, or between 62 and 80 % milk fat.

facts.v: Solid, malleable emulsion, mainly water-in-oil, made only from milk and/or certain milk products; the fat is the essential constituent of value
